name: raindrop-client
description: Tailwind build for the RainDrop client stylesheet.

why: client/tailwind.min.css used to be a checked-in build with no way to regenerate it.
Any utility class written after that build produced no CSS at all, silently:
z-[400] never applied, and a button could render white text on a transparent
background. Run build:css after changing any className.
The JSX bundle is built by pipeline/transpile_frontend.py, which setup.sh and
setup.ps1 already call. It is not duplicated here because it needs Python on
PATH, and an npm script that fails on a clean machine is worse than no script.
